messages.author: f7825395596c3639
messages.subject: rhdfs, rmr code failing with this exception
parts:
Hi, I am trying to run a very simple program (see attached file) and it is failing with this exception.

13/10/10 16:56:27 INFO ipc.Client: Retrying connect to server: 0.0.0.0/0.0.0.0:8032. Already tried 0 time(s); retry policy is RetryUpToMaximumCountWithFixedSleep(maxRetries=10, sleepTime=1 SECONDS)

messages.author: f4bbd7257df1c8bb
messages.subject: Re: rhdfs, rmr code failing with this exception
parts:
8032 is the YARN RM port (yarn.resourcemanager.address), looks like the YARM RM is not running or is configured to listen on a different port. I don't think the exception has to do anything with rmr2 or rhdfs.

Thanks,
Praveen
